---
title: "Capacity Overview"
subtitle: "Daily fleet utilization by hub"
---

```{python}
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

con = duckdb.connect("../data/warehouse.duckdb", read_only=True)
daily = con.execute("""
    SELECT hub, region, period_date, total_available, total_used, utilization_pct
    FROM marts.capacity_daily
    ORDER BY period_date
""").df()

fc = con.execute("""
    SELECT hub, model, ds AS period_date, yhat AS utilization_forecast
    FROM forecasts.capacity_utilization
    ORDER BY ds
""").df()
con.close()
```

## Utilization by hub

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Trend

```{python}
fig = px.line(
    daily, x="period_date", y="utilization_pct", color="hub",
    labels={"period_date": "Date", "utilization_pct": "Utilization (%)", "hub": "Hub"},
)
fig.add_hline(y=90, line_dash="dash", line_color="red",
              annotation_text="90% capacity threshold")
fig.update_layout(height=450, legend_title=None)
fig.show()
```

### Last 30 days

```{python}
recent = daily[daily["period_date"] >= daily["period_date"].max() - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
fig = px.line(
    recent, x="period_date", y="utilization_pct", color="hub",
    labels={"period_date": "Date", "utilization_pct": "Utilization (%)", "hub": "Hub"},
)
fig.add_hline(y=90, line_dash="dash", line_color="red")
fig.update_layout(height=450, legend_title=None)
fig.show()
```

### Available vs used

```{python}
agg = (
    daily.groupby("hub", as_index=False)[["total_available", "total_used"]]
    .mean()
    .melt(id_vars="hub", var_name="metric", value_name="vehicles")
)
fig = px.bar(
    agg, x="hub", y="vehicles", color="metric", barmode="group",
    labels={"hub": "Hub", "vehicles": "Avg vehicles/day", "metric": ""},
)
fig.update_layout(height=420)
fig.show()
```

:::

## 30-day utilization forecast

```{python}
recent = daily[daily["period_date"] >= daily["period_date"].max() - pd.Timedelta(days=60)]
fig = px.line(
    recent, x="period_date", y="utilization_pct", color="hub",
    labels={"period_date": "Date", "utilization_pct": "Utilization (%)", "hub": "Hub"},
)
for hub, hub_fc in fc.groupby("hub"):
    fig.add_scatter(
        x=hub_fc["period_date"], y=hub_fc["utilization_forecast"],
        mode="lines", line=dict(dash="dot"), name=f"{hub} (forecast)",
    )
fig.add_hline(y=90, line_dash="dash", line_color="red")
fig.update_layout(height=480, legend_title=None)
fig.show()
```
